digest.en: Tensions between the US and Iran dominate headlines. The UN demands Israel release flotilla activists. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson says ties with India are flourishing.

articles.title: UN demands Israel immediately releases flotilla activists
articles.summary: The United Nations has called on Israel to immediately release two activists detained on a flotilla bound for Gaza. Israel has not commented on the UN's demand. The activists were detained on a ship attempting to reach Gaza.

articles.title: World Cup Dynamic Ticket Pricing Drives Argentine Soccer Fans To Extremes
articles.summary: Argentina's soccer fans face high ticket prices at the World Cup due to dynamic pricing. The tournament has become the most expensive in history, prompting fans to seek extreme measures to obtain tickets. Many fans are struggling to afford tickets.

articles.title: Trump threatens Iran with ‘higher level’ bombing if it doesn't reopen Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Iran has expressed interest in a "comprehensive agreement" with the US. The Strait of Hormuz has been virtually shut since February 28, blocking about 20% of world oil supplies. articles.title: Iran is now a superpower; ties with India are flourishing: Iran Foreign Ministry spokesperson
articles.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Mr. Baqaei, stated that Iran's ties with India are flourishing. He also mentioned that Tehran is reviewing America's response to its peace proposal. The proposal aims to improve relations between Iran and the US.

articles.title: CNN founder Ted Turner, a brash and outspoken television pioneer, has died at age 87
articles.summary: Ted Turner, the founder of CNN and a television pioneer, has died at the age of 87. He transformed an Atlanta TV station into a satellite-based "superstation" and founded the first 24-hour news network, CNN. Turner was known for his outspoken personality.

articles.title: 3 strokes of caning for bullying: Singapore’s radical new rule for boys
articles.summary: Singapore has introduced a new rule imposing three strokes of caning for bullying. The rule specifically targets boys and aims to curb bullying behavior in schools. The punishment is part of a broader effort to maintain discipline and safety in Singapore's education system.

articles.title: Iran war angle in White House dinner shooting? US probes motive behind Cole Tomas Allen’s attack
articles.summary: US authorities are investigating the motive behind Cole Tomas Allen's attack at a White House dinner, with some speculating about a possible Iran angle. Allen, a 29-year-old man, was shot by Secret Service agents after attempting to breach the event.

articles.title: Ceasefire in a page: US, Iran shrink war to a memo
articles.summary: The US and Iran have agreed to a ceasefire, with the terms outlined in a single-page memo. The agreement marks a significant shift in the conflict, with both sides seeking to reduce tensions.

articles.title: Four killed in post-election violence in India’s West Bengal
articles.summary: Four people were killed in post-election violence in India's West Bengal, where the ruling BJP won the state election for the first time. The unrest has gripped the key eastern state, with reports of clashes between supporters and opponents.

articles.title: How I Got My Career in Foreign Policy: Liana Fix
articles.summary: Liana Fix, a foreign policy expert, has spoken about her career path in a recent interview. Fix, a Council on Foreign Relations fellow, has worked on various international projects and has written extensively on global issues.

articles.title: Leo XIV Is the First Pope From the U.S. He’s Making That an Asset.
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV, the first American pontiff, has used his papacy to challenge Washington, defying concerns about his election. A year into his role, Leo has shown a willingness to take a more assertive stance on global issues.

articles.title: India's Paytm forecasts higher revenue growth in FY 2027
articles.summary: The company expects an increase in revenue, though specific targets have not been disclosed, indicating a positive outlook for the financial year. India's Paytm forecasts higher revenue growth in FY 2027.

articles.title: Israeli strikes on Lebanon kill 4 despite ceasefire
articles.summary: Israeli strikes on Lebanon killed four people, occurring despite a ceasefire. The strikes have resulted in casualties, highlighting the ongoing tensions in the region. Israeli strikes on Lebanon kill 4 despite ceasefire.

articles.title: Indonesia’s new(ish) aircraft carrier: defence boost or expensive gamble?
articles.summary: Indonesia is set to acquire its first aircraft carrier, the Giuseppe Garibaldi. The Indonesian Naval Chief stated it will be used for non-war military operations, aiming to boost maritime capabilities.
